summary: Flush MDF pet gate in a pressure frame with the lift latch on the post; the hinge edge of the leaf and the frame post render as a serrated seam (coincident faces z-fighting), no visible gap or overlap otherwise.

findings.description: The hinge edge of the open leaf shows a jagged interleaved seam against the frame post over its full height, the pattern coplanar faces produce; faces are coincident rather than clearly interpenetrating.
findings.where: open / mechanism close-up (top hinge / pivot); open / close-up

triage.note: z-fighting of coincident faces; the clearance gate (2 mm) passes this door, so the overlap is at most cosmetic

model: claude-fable-5-1 (Claude Code agent, sheets viewed directly)
